summary: Bootstrapped a fresh 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (RHEL9) since no etcd existed previously, loaded it with application keys, then simulated node3's permanent, unrecoverable loss by wiping its data dir and removing its member ID from the cluster. Added a brand-new member identity on node3, started it in 'existing' cluster-state so it joined and resynced via raft, restoring a healthy 3-member cluster with all original keys intact. Completed the mandatory per-node restart protocol: captured boot-id baselines, restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed each boot-id changed, and verified full cluster health/membership/key data after each restart.
actions_performed: Checked all 3 nodes: etcd was not installed anywhere (greenfield)
Installed etcd v3.7.1 binaries on node1, node2, node3
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 on all nodes
Created systemd units and bootstrapped a new 3-member etcd cluster (initial-cluster-state=new) across node1/node2/node3
Verified 3/3 member health and wrote application keys (/app/config/db_host, /app/config/feature_flag, /app/service/name)
Verified keys replicated to all 3 members (baseline healthy state)
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped etcd, disabled service, wiped /var/lib/etcd data
Confirmed node3 endpoint unreachable/unhealthy while node1/node2 retained quorum
Removed dead node3 member ID from cluster via etcdctl member remove
Added new member identity for node3 via etcdctl member add (peer URL http://10.100.6.12:2380)
Reconfigured node3 systemd unit to initial-cluster-state=existing and started etcd
Verified new node3 member joined, resynced via raft snapshot, and cluster returned to 3/3 healthy members with all application keys intact
Captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded ack), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified cluster/member/key health
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified cluster/member/key health
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified cluster/member/key health

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster with application keys before disruption
evidence.summary: member list shows node1/node2/node3 all 'started'; endpoint health shows all 3 true; /app/* keys written and confirmed present on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost, data unrecoverable, quorum preserved during disruption
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped/disabled and /var/lib/etcd wiped; subsequent health check shows node3 endpoint false/context deadline exceeded while node1 and node2 remain true (2/3 quorum intact)

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and replaced with a new working member on node3, cluster back to 3 healthy members
evidence.summary: old node3 member ID (6f3c6332c5f72272) removed; new member added (59ee60b349e224fa) with existing-cluster state; etcd started active on node3; member list and endpoint health show 3/3 healthy members with the new node3 ID

evidence.requirement: Existing application keys intact after member replacement
evidence.summary: etcdctl get /app --prefix on node3's new member returns all three original keys (db_host, feature_flag, service/name), proving raft resync restored data without loss

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 377b5195...; systemctl reboot acknowledged then disconnected; post-reboot boot_id 75235b1d... (changed); cluster health 3/3, member list 3 members, /app keys intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id c2f29441...; reboot acknowledged then disconnected; post-reboot boot_id 5bfe960f... (changed); cluster health 3/3, /app keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline (post-replacement), restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 6aa805ba... (captured after member replacement); reboot acknowledged then disconnected; post-reboot boot_id 87f03061... (changed); cluster health 3/3, member list shows new node3 member still present, /app keys intact
